title: Make AI ask YOU questions first

segments.say: Stop answering AI. Make it ask you.
Day three. Make AI interview you first.
segments.show: Day 03. Make AI interview you first.

segments.say: Most people type one vague line, and AI fills the gaps with guesses.
Add one line to any big prompt: before you start, ask me five questions. Answer them. Then let it write.
segments.show: Add one line to any big prompt: before you start, ask me 5 questions. Answer them. Then let it write.

segments.say: Same request. Before: a generic plan. After: a plan built for you.
Ask first. Answer. Then write. Save this.
Tomorrow, day four: break big tasks into steps. Follow so you don't miss it.
